Hello everyone, how many consultations did you get before you decide anybody and how did you know where to get your consultation? Did you just look on here for recommendations or did you mostly get ideas from word-of-mouth? And how many consultations on average did people get before selecting somebody? Thanks everybody.
2

1
Most relevant﻿
Elaine Lond
 
·
22w
Ask for recommendations from your internist, OBGYN, dermatologist. You’d be surprised what and who they know. I also Googled, used AI and medical publications which review top doctors across the country. Consult with at least 2. At least 2. Also ask on this site. Where do you live???
Reply
Share

Leigh Dolan Schilling
 
·
22w
I asked dermatologist and then also researched docs in areas who do deep plane technique. I was interested in those trained by Dr. Andrew Jacono vs. Dr. Jeffrey Rosenberg, two pioneers for this. Then I went to three consults, did my research, asked them all the same questions asked follow up questions, compared and contrasted everything I learned and made a decision.
